goal: Find a product by name or brand in a few seconds; see featured products.
workflow: Enter search term in the search box
firstView: What Clean Cart is in one line, a search box, and a few featured products
primaryAction: Search for products or navigate to Saved

sections.title: App Introduction
sections.purpose: Introduce Clean Cart's purpose to the shopper.

sections.title: Search and Categories
sections.purpose: Enable shopper to search or browse by category.

sections.title: Featured Products
sections.purpose: Show top-rated or popular products to attract attention.

states.loading: Shows skeleton loaders for content while loading
states.empty: Displays a message like 'No products found' if search returns nothing
states.error: Displays an error message if data fails to load
states.success: Displays the home screen with featured products and search box

responsive: On phone, top bar becomes sticky with search and ZIP code; bottom navigation appears.
accessibility: Search box is keyboard accessible with proper labels; buttons have ARIA roles.
